announcements.headline: Annual Financial Report

announcements.headline: Unaudited Condensed Financial Information
announcements.insight: As a core component of the Investec Group's dual-listed structure, this release provides critical visibility into the UK banking subsidiary's performance, which is currently navigating higher funding costs and a challenging mortgage market environment distinct from its wealth management arm.
